__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Name of the Prometheus datasource to use

description: CLPR EVM Relay — operational metrics dashboard covering sync health, bundle content, EVM account state, and per-peer stats.

panels.description: ETH balance of the signing account. Alert if this approaches zero.
panels.title: Account balance (ETH)

panels.description: Cached nonce for the signing account. Should increase monotonically.
panels.title: Current nonce

panels.description: Rate of EVM listener poll iterations that threw an exception, by channel. Sustained non-zero values indicate a persistent JSON-RPC connectivity or contract read failure.
panels.title: Listener poll failures / sec

panels.description: Rate at which the peer endpoint cache was replaced from the on-ledger roster after a peer-config-timestamp advance, by channel. An initial refresh fires once at startup per channel.
panels.title: Roster refreshes / sec

panels.description: Rate at which the trust anchor bytes changed for each channel. Non-zero values indicate the verifier is actively updating the anchor.
panels.title: Trust anchor changes / sec

panels.description: Last observed EIP-1559 base fee on the chain.
panels.title: Base fee per gas (wei)

panels.description: CLPR protocol version implemented by this relay.
panels.title: Protocol version

panels.description: Rate of EVM transactions submitted and reverted, by channel.
panels.title: TX submissions / sec

panels.description: Rate of failed transaction submissions, broken down by failure reason.
panels.title: TX failures / sec by reason

panels.description: Rate of signing-account nonce resets. Each reset means a transaction was rejected due to a stale or conflicting nonce and the relay will re-fetch the nonce on the next attempt.
panels.title: TX nonce resets / sec

panels.description: Rate of total sync cycles attempted, by channel.
panels.title: Sync cycles / sec

panels.description: Rate of sync cycles that threw an exception, by channel.
panels.title: Failed cycles / sec by reason

panels.description: Rate of peer bundles submitted on-chain (outbound sync path), by channel.
panels.title: Bundle submissions / sec

panels.description: Rate of bundles skipped because they were behind local chain state.
panels.title: Stale skips / sec

panels.description: Cycles skipped because no peer was available or no proof was cached.
panels.title: No-peer / no-proof skips / sec

panels.description: Rate of inbound gRPC sync requests received from peers, by channel.
panels.title: Inbound sync RPCs / sec

panels.description: Rate of messages received in inbound peer bundles and submitted on-chain.
panels.title: Inbound bundle messages / sec

panels.description: Throughput of bundle payloads in bytes per second.
panels.title: Bundle bytes / sec

panels.description: Rate of inbound sync RPCs that failed verification or submission.
panels.title: gRPC sync errors / sec by reason

panels.description: Rate of outbound peer sync RPCs attempted, by channel.
panels.title: Outbound sync attempts / sec

panels.description: Inbound sync RPCs that passed endpoint signature verification, broken down by peer address. Shows which peers are actively calling this relay.
panels.title: Inbound authenticated syncs / sec by peer

panels.description: Rate of successful outbound sync RPCs, broken down by channel and peer address.
panels.title: Per-peer sync success / sec

panels.description: Rate of failed outbound sync RPCs, broken down by channel and peer address.
panels.title: Per-peer sync errors / sec

list.description: Name of the Prometheus datasource to use
list.label: Prometheus
list.name: prometheus
